notes.text: The document claims that a category is described by a pro-finite fundamental group of (Z,G), an extension of G by the usual fundamental group of Z, subject to a connectedness qualification. It discusses the role of normality in full faithfulness, restriction to an open set where the covering is principal, and an equivalence supplied by descent. The second paragraph passes from one ramification model to infinitely many and to local models with compatibility conditions. These are document claims, not verified theorems in this reading.

Only scan 29/036, its supplied C and H drafts, C prior questions, notation snapshot, brief and preamble were accessed. No other reader or page was accessed. No OCR, extraction, recognition library, internet or published comparison was used.

Exactly one whole-image view, one view of each original-resolution half, and one view of each of 13 tight crops. No full half was enlarged or reopened; no crop target was recropped. All crops were made from the original whole image, autocontrasted and enlarged with Pillow LANCZOS to 2600 pixels across; none was rotated or sharpened.

Differences include content/state/placement and explicit uncertainty, not raw macro names or ordinary wrapping/spacing. Per the common clarification, H struck/ill/emph are treated as potentially equivalent to deleted/illegible/underline; its emph on the two underlined words is not counted as a difference. H marked_in_H refers to whether the relevant uncertainty or issue is marked; a struck marker alone does not mark a reading doubt.

27 physical typewritten body lines, two paragraphs, two typed supra-linear additions, four clearly x-cancelled textual units (one word, one intraword letter, one two-letter fragment, one longer fragment), two continuous underlines, and one pencil archive number. No title, heading, dateline, signature, authorial page number, total page count, display, diagram or drawing is visible.

Visible unusual forms retained: developped (doubled p), pther (initial p), catégory (acute), twp, (p and comma). Uncertain spellings retained explicitly: classifind|classified, because|befause, wosse|worse, models|modals; the deleted final fragment is ar|as. The missing endings of fixed, interested, of and worse are not claimed to have been recovered.

In the nature is clearly above the line, with no visible caret or arrow. Its printed anchor after restriction follows the immediate spatial relation to the terminal part of that word; the exact attachment is not graphically fixed and remains in unresolved. S-prime is immediately above the gap between coverings and of, likewise without a visible caret, but that local attachment is visually well determined.

Dense overprinting in because, wosse/worse and models/given is described rather than converted into invented chronological correction layers. No distinct earlier/cancelled letter is securely separable at those cells, unlike the explicit x-cancelled s, fr and larger fragments.

No mathematical argument was used to fill the blank between Z-prime and Z-prime/G or between U and V. The absent arrow/intersection are transcription decisions from the visible empty intervals. Ordinary serif capitals, upper n/lower a, lower dotted i and apostrophe-shaped primes were determined visually. No genuine proof check or re-proof was performed; checks is therefore empty.

The body and both additions are typewritten. The two continuous underlines appear drawn rather than made of separately struck underscores; authorship is not identifiable from this page alone. The pencil archive number is an unnamed hand, retained only as a comment.
